spans.s: (I)--a son of Yadu. भा. IX. २३. २०; Vi. IV. ११. 5.
(II)--a Vanara son of Agni born by the wife of Kanakabindu. Br.

(V)--the son of निषध, hence नैषध; with the son of वीरसेन he made the two Nalas in the कश्यप line;
1: M. १२. ५२, ५६; वा. ८८. २०२.
taught the game of dice to King ऋतुपर्ण.
2: भा.
(VII)--also known as Nandanodaradundubhi, son of Taittiri, performed अश्वमेध, and in the middle of the अतिरात्र rite Punarvasu appeared and became his son. M. ४४. ६३-5.
--a people of the southern country. वा. ४५. १२७.

--a son of Kubera and ऋद्धि; as an attendant of Rudra became very proud and with his brother मणिग्रीव enjoyed maidens' embrace on the Ganges, all naked. नारद saw this when the ladies put on their dress while नलकूबर and his brother continued to remain nak- ed owing to their drunkenness. The sage cursed them to become trees for a hundred divine years without losing the पूर्ववासन। So they stood till कृष्ण redeemed them by bringing down the trees; their prayer to कृष्ण; set out to the north, permitted by कृष्ण. भा.

(I)--one of the eastern entrances of the city of पुरञ्जन
1: भा. IV. २५. ४८.
allegorically the nostrils.
2: Ib. २९. ११.
(II)--one of the wives of अजमीढ and mother of नील. भा. IX. २१. ३०. Vi. IV. १९. ५६.
(III)--a R. in शाकद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ९६; Vi.
(IV)--digging of lakes at the auspicious hour; the same prescription as for the excavation of तदाग; is also पुष्करणि. M. ५८. 1, ५१.
--one of the Eastern entrances to the city of Puranjana; allegorically the nostrils. भा. IV. २५. ४८; २९. ११.

--a measurement in connection with the chariot of Maya;
1: M. १७३. 2; Br.

. १२५; ३६. ४९.
the seat of हिरण्यकशिपु in his सभा was १० nalvas in measurement;
2: M. १६१. ७१.
a furlong in distance; ३०० dhanus.
3: वा. ८३. ४९; १०१. १२५.

(I) (पादिकस्)--reckoned from four perforated golden माषस् of four inches each;
1: वा. १००. २२०.
reckoned from the move- ment of the moon.
2: Ib. ६६. ४५.

--the coconut as illustrating the rela- tion between Brahman and the Universe. Vi.
--a measurement (Jalaprastha) equal to four overflowing मागध measure. Br.
